paper.title_en: Measurement of the transverse momentum dependent (TMD) longitudinal single-spin asymmetry of W bosons at RHIC-STAR
paper.abstract_en: Understanding the three-dimensional spin structure of the nucleon is one of the key questions in QCD physics. Among the transverse-momentum-dependent (TMD) PDFs, the TMD helicity distributions are in particular poorly constrained. Measurement of the transverse-momentum-dependent longitudinal single-spin asymmetry (\(A_L\)) of \(W\) bosons in polarized \(p + p\) collisions at RHIC provides a unique opportunity to access the flavor-separated TMD helicity distributions of quarks and antiquarks. The \(W\) bosons are identified via their leptonic decay channel (\(W \to e + \nu\)), and their full kinematics are constructed by using a recoil-based method. In this contribution, we present the motivation, analysis procedure, and preliminary results for the \(W\) \(A_L\) measurement as a function of the reconstructed \(W\) transverse momentum, based on the dataset collected by STAR in longitudinally polarized \(p + p\) collisions at \(\sqrt{s} = 510\ \mathrm{GeV}\) in 2013. These results will serve as an important input for future QCD global fits of TMD helicity distributions, especially for the poorly constrained sea-quark helicities.
